description: Java class implementing a service module for Verisign PayFlow Pro payment processing, including methods for authorization, capture, void, refund, and PayPal express checkout integration, with detailed response parsing and configuration handling.

classes.name: PayflowPro
classes.description: Service class providing payment processing methods for Verisign PayFlow Pro, including authorization, capture, void, refund, and PayPal express checkout integration.

methods.name: ccProcessor
methods.description: Handles credit card authorization via PayFlow Pro API, supporting PayPal and card payments, with response parsing and configuration-based behavior.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction, with response handling.

methods.name: ccVoid
methods.description: Voids a transaction, with response parsing.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a captured transaction, with response handling.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initiates a PayPal express checkout, requesting a token and redirect URL, including cart details.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes an express checkout by obtaining checkout details and creating a payment method.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Finalizes a PayPal express checkout by executing the payment with the token and payer ID.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses response string from PayFlow API into a key-value map.

methods.name: parseAuthResponse
methods.description: Processes authorization response, extracting result codes, AVS, CVV, and setting result flags.

methods.name: parseCaptureResponse
methods.description: Processes capture response, extracting success or failure info.

methods.name: parseVoidResponse
methods.description: Processes void response, extracting success or failure info.

methods.name: parseRefundResponse
methods.description: Processes refund response, extracting success or failure info.

methods.name: addCartDetails
methods.description: Adds shopping cart item details to PayPal request parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes PayFlow API connection with configuration parameters.
